description: This Java class is an implementation of a Data Access Object (DAO) for product attributes, providing methods to query product attribute data from the database using QueryDSL with Spring annotations.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductAttributeDao interface, providing database query methods for ProductAttribute entities based on various criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute by its ID, joining related entities for comprehensive fetch.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific product option ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes filtered by a list of attribute IDs and merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches ProductAttributes based on a specific product option value ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes linked to a specific product, merchant store, and language, including related descriptions.
